name: Kiet Music club
description:
KIET Music Club (KMC) is a cultural society dedicated to music and performance.

Actively participates in intra & inter - college events.

Organizes musical events and represents KIET externally

Focuses on nurturing talent in singing, instruments, and performance.

achievements.title: Epoque@Prastuti 2026 Success
achievements.desc: Secured major wins including 1st Position in Solo Singing (Khushi Shakya), Winner in Group Singing (Tarang), Winner in Beatboxing (Pratham Saxena), and Runner-up in Band War (Advait).

achievements.title: External Competitive Excellence
achievements.desc: Achieved consistent top positions across 2025-26 at prestigious institutions including IIT Mandi, LBSIM, HIMT, Jaipuria, Razzmatazz, and Shobhit Institute.

achievements.title: Epoque@Prastuti 2025 Victories
achievements.desc: Achieved multiple wins including Group Singing (Swaraang), Solo Singing (Shivani Tiwari), Beatboxing (Pratham Saxena), and Battle of Bands (Vaani).

events.title: Epoque@Prastuti 2026
events.desc: The annual cultural fest held at KIET Campus from April 2–4, 2026, featuring high-caliber inter and intra-institute musical competitions.

events.title: External Participation
events.desc: Active participation in inter-college musical competitions throughout the 2025-26 academic year, showcasing KMC talent at events like Spriesta and Sangeetam.

events.title: Epoque@Prastuti 2025
events.desc: A major cultural fest held from March 27–29, 2025, serving as a key platform for KMC's competitive success.
